# Vendored TMLR style

This directory contains the unmodified official `tmlr.sty` used to build the
anonymous submission layout.

- Upstream: https://github.com/JmlrOrg/tmlr-style-file
- Pinned commit: `7bf90efe3a0debbba703c05c43f3ff7e4d4a2992`
- `tmlr.sty` SHA-256: `816214ff5919aa457b6b443bee52b15d9561421417b7f8a50cc84651519f0002`
- License: Apache-2.0; the upstream license is reproduced in `LICENSE`.

Do not edit the vendored style. Update it only by reviewing and pinning a new
upstream commit, then rebuilding and visually checking the complete paper.
